data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘phōrós’, meaning ‘bright’ or ‘shining’, Furiya represents the light of joy and happiness. In Christian tradition, Furiya is believed to symbolize the joy and peace that comes from a deep connection with God. The name Furiya carries the meaning “Light, Joy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Furiya usually hope their child will grow to embody light, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
